title: AARYA Voice Package Manifest
description: The manifest.json contract inside an .arya-voice.zip package -- the versioned bridge between Voice Lab (produces packages) and AARYA Core's Voice Package Manager (consumes them). Voice Lab does not implement AARYA Core; this schema only defines the contract at the boundary. A 'private_voice' type is deliberately NOT a valid value here -- see docs/VOICE_PACKAGE_SPEC.md for why private-voice models must never be distributed through this package format.

format.description: Fixed marker identifying this file as an AARYA voice package manifest.

format_version.description: Semver of this manifest contract itself (not the voice model's own version).

type.description: Deliberately excludes 'private_voice' -- see docs/SECURITY.md's frontend_direct_access/distribution_restricted rules for the Private Voice model. This package format is a distribution artifact; a private voice must never gain a path to one.

provider.description: e.g. 'local', or a specific open-source project name -- same convention as schemas/model_registry.schema.json's provider field.

languages.description: BCP-47-ish language tags this voice actually supports -- never inferred from a training corpus's general language mix.

model_format.description: Matches pipeline.model_artifact.ModelArtifactFormat exactly -- a format absent from this list must not be silently accepted.

runtime_requirements.description: e.g. {'compute_backend': 'cpu', 'min_runtime_version': '1.0.0'}. Free-form on purpose, matching model_registry.schema.json's hardware_requirements pattern -- structure may evolve without a schema change.

license.description: Never left blank to imply a permissive default -- see docs/DATA_POLICY.md's identical rule for datasets, applied here to models.

provenance.description: How/from what this voice was produced -- e.g. a training_job_id or dataset registry reference.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the packaged model artifact -- same naming convention as pipeline.model_artifact.ModelArtifact.checksum_sha256.
